prompt: Write 10 distinct lessons the mortgage-underwriting agent (residential mortgage applications and remortgages) at Larkmere Mutual learned across many cases about: an arrears payment plan. Each is a working pattern or tip for the next case, not about any one member, one or two sentences, in the agent's voice ("When…, …"). Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"observation","content":"When an applicant has a recent arrears payment plan, check whether every instalment has been made on time and in full before treating the account as stable."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the payment plan is still active, use the lender’s own conduct over the planned period as the main indicator, rather than relying only on the headline arrears balance."},{"type":"observation","content":"When the plan was set up after a short-term payment shock, I look for a clear recovery pattern and no further missed payments before I become comfortable."},{"type":"preference","content":"When the applicant can explain the cause of the arrears and it was a one-off event, I prefer to see evidence that the issue has genuinely been resolved."},{"type":"observation","content":"When the payment plan has been repeatedly amended or extended, I treat that as a warning sign that affordability may still be under strain."},{"type":"fact","content":"When a remortgage is requested solely to clear arrears, I check that the new monthly payment and term do not simply defer the problem into the future."},{"type":"observation","content":"When arrears arose from variable income, I look for recent income stability before accepting the payment plan as a reliable sign of recovery."},{"type":"preference","content":"When the customer has maintained the payment plan for several months and reduced the balance as agreed, I am more comfortable than when the plan was only just started."},{"type":"observation","content":"When there is any break in the plan, even a small one, I review the full account history rather than assuming the later payments have cured the earlier stress."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the application is otherwise strong, a well-managed arrears payment plan can still be acceptable, but only if the overall affordability and credit profile support it."}]}
